# Shared repository instructions

Read and follow [the root AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before working in this repository.
For changes under `src/`, also read [frontend instructions](../src/AGENTS.md).
For changes under `backend/`, also read [backend instructions](../backend/AGENTS.md).
Load these files explicitly when they are not already in context.

Use [development commands](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) for setup and verification, and
[the collaboration workflow](../docs/agents/README.md) for ownership and handoff.
Keep shared policy in the canonical `AGENTS.md` files instead of copying it here.
